prompt: Write a one-star review of the Statue of Liberty from a reviewer who is upset that you have to take a boat.
response:
**★☆☆☆☆ Absolutely ridiculous. Build a bridge!**

If I could give zero stars, I would. 

Nowhere on the official brochures does it clearly state that this thing is in the literal middle of the ocean and you are FORCED to take a boat to get to it. I booked a walking tour of New York and thought we could just stroll up, take a quick selfie, and go grab a slice of pizza. Nope. 

Apparently, in the year of our Lord 2024, New York City still hasn't figured out how to build a bridge or a tunnel to one of its biggest tourist traps. What do you mean my Uber driver can’t drop me off at the entrance? Instead, you have to stand in a massive line, go through airport-level security, and board a crowded, smelly ferry that rocks back and forth. I don’t *do* boats. I get incredibly seasick, and the wind completely ruined my hair before I even got close enough to see her green face. 

The whole process wasted my entire morning. It is completely unacceptable that there isn't a parking lot next to it. They are just using the water to force you to buy ferry tickets. Save your money, save your stomach, and just look at a picture on Google. Complete scam.
